rics.meaning: Manufacturing corporations after-tax profits — Census Quarterly Financial Report (QFR). Covers all manufacturing.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with industrial production and ISM Manufacturing for the full mfg cycle picture. Profit margins (profits/sales) here lead capex decisions. Look at YoY change rather than level.

rics.description: Manufacturing corporations, after-tax profits, all durable manufacturing
rics.meaning: After-tax profits for durable-goods manufacturing (autos, machinery, electronics, fab metals). QFR.
rics.how_to_use: Durables are the cyclical heart of mfg — leads the broader cycle. Pair with new orders for durable goods to gauge order-book to bottom-line transmission.

rics.description: Manufacturing corporations, after-tax profits, all nondurable manufacturing
rics.meaning: After-tax profits for nondurable-goods manufacturing (food, chemicals, petroleum, textiles, paper). QFR.
rics.how_to_use: Less cyclical than durables; more sensitive to commodity input costs. Petroleum sub-component swings the headline — strip it out for trend.

rics.description: Retail trade corporations, income (or loss) after income taxes
rics.meaning: Retail trade corporations, after-tax income or loss. QFR.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check with retail sales: persistent retail sales growth without profit growth implies margin compression (most likely from labor/rent). Useful for sector valuation context.

rics.description: Retail trade corporations, income (or loss) from operations
rics.meaning: Retail trade corporations, income or loss from operations (pre-tax operating income).
rics.how_to_use: Pre-tax operating proxy for the retail sector — strips out tax effects and one-offs. Use the after-tax line for valuation, this for operational health.

rics.description: Retail trade corporations, net sales, receipts and operating revenues
rics.meaning: Retail trade corporations, net sales, receipts and operating revenues. The top line of QFR retail.
rics.how_to_use: Differs from BLS retail sales: QFR is corporation-level (excludes sole proprietors), quarterly, more volatile. Use BLS retail sales for the headline; this for sector earnings context.
